patches.title: Hold Object Before Appliance
patches.principle: Do not approach transformation appliances unless holding the object to be transformed.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning, heating, or cooling.

patches.title: Open Surfaces Priority
patches.principle: Search all open surfaces (countertops, tables) before opening any closed containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and open surfaces remain.

patches.title: Direct Post-Transform Placement
patches.principle: After transforming an object, go directly to the destination and place it, avoiding any intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after cleaning, heating, or cooling an object.
